purpose: Exploratory train-only capture-confound probe of five expert /R/ ratings
featureExtraction: Read only the 766 selected author-train mono PCM16 16 kHz WAVs after verifying their bytes against the pinned official archive. Duration is PCM frame count divided by 16000. RMS is sqrt(mean((int16 sample / 32768)^2)) over every frame, including silence.
model: One-hot target words learned from fit speakers only, one adult age indicator, and optionally duration and RMS. Standardize each column on fit clips only; zero-variance columns use scale one. Fit a three-class linear softmax to five-rater class proportions with L2 weight penalty and unpenalized intercept.
selectionMetric: Lowest inner-speaker per-rater natural-log loss; smallest L2 candidate breaks ties. Refit selected candidate on all outer-train speakers.
optimizer: Torch CPU float64 LBFGS strong_wolfe, zero initialization, max 400 iterations, history 10
brierDefinition: Mean across all five raters of the sum of squared probability errors over three one-hot classes
